messages.subject: Cedar — key risks before the 26 Nov session
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Ahead of the negotiation on 26 November I've drafted the advice note for Robert and Grace (Project_Cedar_AdviceNote_KeyRisks). The three points I want your steer on:

1. Exclusivity — narrowed at HoT stage but Caldera's MSA draft has crept back to 'products derived from the specification'. I want to tie it firmly to the Schedule 1 assemblies.
2. Product-liability carve-out — uncapped save for the £25m insurance line. Given the aerospace exposure this is the real risk; I'll insist we confirm Halstead's aviation products cover before signature.
3. IPR licence-back — needs to be perpetual and royalty-free so Halstead keeps its process know-how.

Comfortable to send to the client?

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Sarah
